1.explanation: These four documentation files cover the two components shown in the bug scenario images. The `Modal.mdx` and its overview document declare and describe the `aria-label` prop for the Modal header, while `ComboBox.mdx` and its overview describe the `ariaLabel` prop on the ComboBox. Reviewing and updating these files is essential to refactor both components to consistently support the hyphen-cased `aria-label` prop and maintain backwards compatibility.
1.bug_scenario: The provided screenshots highlight an inconsistency in how ARIA label props are named across Carbon React components. In the Modal component (first image), the Storybook control shows a hyphen-cased prop `aria-label`, whereas in the ComboBox component (second image), the control lists a camel-cased prop `ariaLabel`. According to React’s WAI-ARIA guidelines, all `aria-*` attributes should use hyphen-case. This mismatch leads to confusion and potential backwards-compatibility issues when developers try to use the same prop name in different components.
